expectedBehavior: Use an explicit Mac dotnet executable to capture the active reference stack and build the HelloIos and AotProbe fixtures.
observedBehavior: Both reports identify /usr/local/share/dotnet as the selected 10.0.402 SDK root, workload set 10.0.401.1, macios 27.0.10722, and Xcode/iPhoneOS 27.0. HelloIos failed at provisioning-profile discovery before AOT, native linking, or app-bundle output. AotProbe built successfully but emitted only managed AotProbe.dll because it is a class library.
limitations: No profile was available to HelloIos, so the capture does not prove signing, AOT execution, native linking, bundle creation, installation, or device execution.
The source capture used a relative binary-log path after changing to the project directory. The reports name project-local binlog paths, but no binlogs were supplied with the capture directories.
No global.json governed the captured build, and no repository revision or source-file hashes were captured.
Report and inventory files are local-only ignored artifacts because they contain host and user-path information.
nextDecision: Re-run HelloIos with the hardened capture script and an available local profile selected either by private project configuration or a redacted -p:CodesignProvision selector. Retain the private binlog and record only its hash in a new sanitized receipt.

commands.command: Read and SHA-256 verify supplied local-only HelloIos and AotProbe Mac reports and their inventory files.
Inspect the supplied report build outcomes and the fixture project types without executing a build.

excluded: profile selectors, profile files, credentials, and signing identities
Apple SDK files and device records
